messages:
elaine: Quick heads-up — the base-image rebuild scheduled Tue 02:00 UTC will overlap with the keystore KMS signer rotation window (02:15-02:45). If the signer rotates mid-bake cosign signing fails and images won't be published. Can we delay the rebuild or add a rotation-hold for that key? cc @raj @marco

raj: Ack. Do we know which key reference the buildfarm uses? cluster KMS key or an ephemeral operator key?

elaine: It uses the cluster key at keystore://projects/redwood/keys/image-signer (KMS-backed). Build job fetches a key-ref via the keystore service and then runs cosign in the bake pod. If KMS returns a transient error or the key is momentarily unavailable we get a hard exit from signing.

marco: We can't export private key (policy). Two pragmatic options: 1) delay rebuild outside rotation window, 2) create an alias (key version alias + label) that we mark with rotationHold for 24h. Option 2 requires a short RBAC tweak so the build service can read the alias.

oncall-sre: Also: add an alert on signing failures. Right now events go to auditpipe but no runbook ties them to a rebuild rollback. Suggest: if >=3 image-sign failures in 10m -> trigger page.

security-bot: [alert] cosign_sign_failed detected in staging (count=4, window=8m). Refer to /auditpipe/events/2026-03/signing-failures for logs.

elaine: Example failure from last night's canary: 
```
2026-03-22T23:58:12Z build-pod-123 cosign: error: failed to sign: rpc error: code = NotFound desc = key not found
```

marco: That matches a KMS key-version race. If we do an alias/hold we need to grant the build SA read access to the alias resource: iam.roles/keystore.viewer or a narrower keystore.keys.get on that alias. Raj, can you draft the least-priv role?

raj: Yep. I'll open a tiny IAM PR. Proposed binding: serviceAccount:build-farm@redwood.iam.gserviceaccount.com -> roles/keystore.keyAccessor (read-only get/verify). Will attach the PR link here shortly.

devops: If we delay, suggest moving the rebuild to Wed 03:30 UTC (after the rotation) and adding a 1h safety buffer. That avoids any RBAC churn. Which do we prefer?

elaine: Preference for alias+hold so we don't postpone the whole rollout cadence. But only if we can: a) push a restricted IAM change, b) set alias with rotationHold, and c) add an alert. If any of those lag, we fallback to delay.

oncall-sre: I'll add the alert now and a temporary escalation rule. If pages happen during the bake window we'll abort rollout and open an incident.

raj: PR opened: https://git.internal/redwood/iam/merge_requests/512 — role + one-line justification. PTAL @marco @elaine

marco: Reviewed, left 1 nit. ETA to apply once approvals done: ~45m. After that I'll create alias and set label rotationHold=2026-03-24T04:00Z.

elaine: Thanks. Action items: 
- raj: land IAM binding (PR 512)
- marco: create keystore alias + set rotationHold label after PR merges
- oncall-sre: enable signing-failure alert and escalation
- devops: tentatively hold Wed 03:30 rebuild slot in calendar until we confirm alias

elaine: If anyone sees new cosign errors after the change, paste the build logs here. We'll treat 3+ failures as abort condition. :thumbsup:
